description: Avaliação da cana-de-açúcar sob irrigação por aspersão no Perímetro Salitre, Juazeiro - BA [CNPS] is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Este plano de informação representa a distribuição espacial da aptidão para cana-de-açúcar irrigada sob o sistema de aspersão para o assentamento Salitre, município de Juazeiro, Bahia. Escala 1:70.000. [CNPS]. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Bahia, Cana-de-açúcar, CNPS, irrigação, Juazeiro. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support irrigation network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
